## 56362868a163

**Reproduced coverage shortcut: cap every component area at 9.** The sampler declares and enforces object sizes of at most 9; seeds 0–999 in each difficulty band (3,000 generated inputs) observed maxima 5, 7 and 9 with no validator failures. A wrong encoder that replaces every area by `min(area, 9)` is therefore indistinguishable on the current generated domain.

The canonical test input has reading-order component areas 7, 3 and 13 and is accepted by the current `self_check`. The true Racket output is 3x13, while `rival_cap9.json` emits a 3x9 output; see `checks/audit/56362868a163/case.json`. Generator SHA-256: `df8f2bf563145895ae5f4d5a9e70d9e694e37f8465f829ece1d345757079b961`; executed rule hash: `b5c1b8b42c22`.

This is a coverage/shortcut finding rather than a mislabeled generated example. No fix was made to this audit target.
